item.title: Shabbat Shalom!
item.description:
Arutz Sheva-Israel National News is stopping its round-the-clock news updates at this time in honor of the start of Shabbat in North America, where they are being written now.

item.title: Six months into war: Cruz urges Trump to arm protesters to trigger Iran regime collapse
item.description:
In an interview, Senator Ted Cruz urges the US to arm anti-government protesters to induce regime collapse in Iran, highlighting growing GOP divides over the six-month war.
(Arutz Sheva-Israel National News' North American desk is keeping you updated until the start of Shabbat in New York. The time posted automatically on all Israel National News articles, however, is Israeli time.)

item.title: Kibbutz Zikim residents cleared to leave safe rooms, advised to stay indoors
item.description:
Residents of Kibbutz Zikim near the border with Gaza, where a breach in the fence was discovered leading to searches by security forces, have been permitted to leave their safe rooms, but have been told to remain inside their homes for the time being.
(Arutz Sheva-Israel National News' North American desk is keeping you updated until the start of Shabbat in New York. The time posted automatically on all Israel National News articles, however, is Israeli time.)

item.description:
Nissim Louk, whose daughter Shani was murdered at Nova Festival, confronts Minister Miri Regev at Mahane Yehuda Market, lashing out at her and Likud: "You brought about October 7th."
(Arutz Sheva-Israel National News' North American desk is keeping you updated until the start of Shabbat in New York. The time posted automatically on all Israel National News articles, however, is Israeli time.)

item.title: IDF searching Kibbutz Zikim following breach discovered in perimeter fence
item.description:
IDF troops are searching Kibbutz Zikim in the Gaza border area after a breach was discovered in the community's perimeter fence. According to security sources, there is no indication of an infiltration from the Gaza Strip at this stage.
The IDF Spokesperson's Unit stated, "A short time ago, forces were summoned to Kibbutz Zikim following a report from the community’s security coordinator regarding a cut discovered in the fence. Upon arrival, troops initiated a sweep of the area. As of now, no suspects have been identified, and it cannot be determined when the breach was made. IDF forces are continuing their search to rule out any security incidents."
(Arutz Sheva-Israel National News' North American desk is keeping you updated until the start of Shabbat in New York. The time posted automatically on all Israel National News articles, however, is Israeli time.)

item.title: IDF: We will not publish any information that could jeopardize our forces
item.description:
The IDF Spokesperson’s Unit issued a statement on Friday evening following reports that it concealed a Hezbollah violation of the ceasefire in southern Lebanon.
“The IDF releases information to the public based strictly on relevant operational considerations and situational assessments. The IDF Spokesperson’s Unit will not publish any information that, according to operational assessments, could jeopardize our forces operating in combat zones."

item.title: 4 men rescued after drifting on inflatable mattress in Sea of Galilee; two treated for dehydration
item.description:
Four men who drifted on the Sea of Galilee while on an inflatable mattress were rescued by Magen David Adom teams. Two of them suffered from dehydration and received initial fluid treatment aboard an MDA intensive care boat. After their condition improved, they did not require evacuation to a hospital.
MDA said that a passerby who was engaged in water sports spotted the incident and alerted the emergency teams.

item.title: United Airlines expected to resume flights to Israel
item.description:
